quotes.quote: Sometimes you're not going to shoot the ball well, especially as a unit. So rebounding and 50-50 balls, those are the margins of the game that you just have to win to give yourself a chance when shots aren't falling at the rate that they normally do.

quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum praises Chris Clemons' performance in place of Neemias Queta
quotes.excerpt: Chris stepped up, especially with Neemias out.
